title: Q-FLOW-QNFO-TWIN: the QNFO fleet's workflow flow map and check
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** every QNFO fleet run
**Done check:** grep:instances/qnfo/flows.json::flows
**Status:** closed

Declare every QNFO workflow's inflows, outflows, bindings and feedback in instances/qnfo and fail the fleet check for an output that feeds no signal or an input with no producer (twin of foundation/flows.py in qnfo-workers _shared/flow-registry.js).

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 218.1 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
